title: 'Watching the Grass Grow' Is Not Fun (1/2)
summaryZh: 以春天草木生長為引子，介紹形容無聊乏味的英文慣用語。
source: VOA Learning English (public domain) — Words and Their Stories

sentences.text: And now, words and their stories from VOA Learning English.
sentences.zh: 接下來是 VOA Learning English 的《詞語背後的故事》單元。

sentences.text: Springtime is a time of renewal and growth.
sentences.zh: 春天是萬物更新、生長的季節。

sentences.text: Many plants end their long winter sleep and form new buds.
sentences.zh: 許多植物結束漫長的冬眠，冒出新芽。

sentences.text: Beautiful flowers will soon be showing their bright colors.
sentences.zh: 美麗的花朵很快就會綻放出鮮豔的顏色。

sentences.text: And the grass will grow thicker and greener again.
sentences.zh: 草地也會再次長得更濃密、更翠綠。

sentences.text: Some flowers bloom in a very noticeable way.
sentences.zh: 有些花開得非常引人注目。

sentences.text: But that is not the case with grass.
Imagine you are sitting in a grassy field.
sentences.zh: 想像你坐在一片草地上。

sentences.text: And you have only one job, to watch the grass grow.
sentences.zh: 而你只有一件工作，就是看著草長大。

sentences.text: That does not sound very interesting.
In fact, it sounds really boring.
sentences.zh: 說真的，聽起來超級無聊。

sentences.text: That idea is what gives us the expression like watching grass grow.
sentences.zh: 這個畫面就是 like watching grass grow 這個說法的由來。

sentences.text: We use this expression to describe an experience that is uninteresting.
sentences.zh: 我們用這個說法來形容一件很無趣的事。

sentences.text: Another good word to describe it is tedious.
sentences.zh: 另一個很適合形容它的字是 tedious。

sentences.text: After the politician won his campaign,
sentences.zh: 那位政治人物勝選之後，
